answer: Grab's Deliveries segment generated **$1,800 million** in revenue in FY2025, up 21% from $1,493 million in FY2024 [Grab, FY2025, p.97-98]. This growth was driven by a 21% increase in deliveries GMV (to $14.2 billion), including contributions from the supermarket business (e.g., Everrise acquisition), while deliveries revenue remained a consistent 13% of GMV in both years [Grab, FY2025, p.98].
